exporter: Lucius Kenshi IO 1.3.2 with installed Blender 5.1 adapter

coordinates.authoring: Blender +X forward +Y left +Z up; current authoring scale preserved
coordinates.native: Kenshi x=Blender x, y=Blender z, z=-Blender y
coordinates.placement: Each mesh/collision uses pivot-relative geometry. Place at pivot_kenshi under the car root; do not place all parts at zero.
coordinates.collision_file: Blender Z-up; Kenshi loadPhysXFile converts to native Y-up exactly once.

assets.light_anchors_space: vehicle root; subtract pivot_kenshi for module-local coordinates
assets.runtime_note: Housing and lens geometry only; beam projection and switching require runtime integration.

validation.status: Run verify-light-frame-assets.py for fresh native readback
validation.passenger_import: See verification.json for fresh native readback.

limitations: Runtime visual, material registration, damage and slot bindings still require integration.
Collision XML contains native cooked convex shapes; no runtime-generated .bin caches are fabricated.
Use group exports OR their individual members, never both simultaneously.
Wheel armor must follow its wheel; front rack and spikes are mutually exclusive.
LOD meshes and in-game collision/driving validation are not included.

atlas.uv_method: Triangles crossing integer UV boundaries are clipped before remapping; source tiled appearance preserved.

rear_layout.rule: Cargo excludes either passenger seat; both passenger seats may coexist.

passenger_import.method: Verified rigid copies reuse existing seat atlas UVs; collision hulls are rotated and cooked in Z-up.
